definitions.explanation: Legally or officially acceptable and usable.
Producing the intended or desired result.

examples.japanese: このクーポンは{来月|らいげつ}まで{有効|ゆうこう}です。
examples.english: This coupon is valid until next month.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}を{有効|ゆうこう}に{使|つか}いましょう。
この{方法|ほうほう}は{有効|ゆうこう}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think this method is effective.

notes:
USAGE: {有効|ゆうこう} is used for both (1) validity of documents, tickets, etc., and (2) effectiveness of methods, measures, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{有効|ゆうこう}{期限|きげん} (expiration date)
・{有効|ゆうこう}に{使|つか}う (to use effectively)
・{有効|ゆうこう}な{手段|しゅだん} (effective means)
・{有効|ゆうこう}{活用|かつよう} (effective utilization)

CONTRAST:
・{無効|むこう} - invalid, ineffective

NOTE: Do not confuse with {友好|ゆうこう} (friendship), which has the same reading.
